primary_task: Review a contract supplied as a file or pasted text against the organization playbook (or generic standards), flagging GREEN/YELLOW/RED deviations with redlines and a business impact summary.

requirements.name: contract as file upload or pasted text
requirements.evidence: Accept the contract in any of these formats: File upload ... URL ... Pasted text (alternatives; any one suffices)

requirements.name: PDF/DOCX text extraction
requirements.evidence: File upload: PDF, DOCX, or other document format
requirements.basis: bash: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, ...)

requirements.name: Box / Egnyte / SharePoint / CLM URL
requirements.evidence: URL: Link to a contract in your CLM, cloud storage (e.g., Box, Egnyte, SharePoint), or other document system
requirements.basis: lacks: connectors or integrations other than the tools listed (only one of three input alternatives)

requirements.name: legal.local.md playbook
requirements.evidence: If no playbook is configured: ... Proceed with a generic review using widely-accepted commercial standards as the baseline
requirements.basis: local settings file; not stated in the manifest; the document gives an explicit fallback

requirements.name: CLM system via MCP
requirements.evidence: If no CLM is connected, skip this step.
requirements.basis: lacks: connectors or integrations other than the tools listed

requirements.name: ask_user (side, deadline, focus, context)
requirements.evidence: Ask the user for context before beginning the review
requirements.basis: ask_user: ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation

notes: Input formats are alternatives, so the unavailable cloud-storage URL does not block. If the user supplied only a SharePoint/Box link the verdict would be BLOCKED for that request. Playbook presence unknown, with a generic fallback.
